description: M07 case index, GROUNDWORK (wave 8; m07-plan §6 "Exit mapping"): the M07 rows that exist today mapped to their Cargo test targets and tests, per platform, in the M02 format (tests/native/m02/case-index.json description). Read by tests/native/m07/m07-evidence.py (wave 9c; m02-evidence.py with the M07 constants, as m05 and m06 did); the records are U9's. Rows that depend on revision 7 (U3's A19 contract tests, U4b, the U5b and U5h remainders, U6, U7) are not listed until they exist. Platform names: macos (the build host), linux (the devbox), windows (Windows 11 native).

e2e_tui_m07::pty::.rationale: rustix pty cases (#[cfg(unix)]). A20's Windows row is e2e_tui_m07 windows_console::windows_tui_walkthrough, on a pseudoconsole (A20 platform_required).

e2e_wrapper_m07.rationale: #![cfg(all(unix, debug_assertions))]: the wrapper's journey uses a Unix socket endpoint; its Windows journey over the named pipe needs verified-hello discovery (D12, U3, revision 7) and is blocked until then.

e2e_harness_m07::journey::both_harnesses.rationale: #[cfg(unix)]: the seven tasks with the Unix fixtures. Windows runs tasks 1-7 as journey::both_harnesses_use_existing_access_on_windows (1, 2, 5, 6, 7) and journey::both_harnesses_use_the_fixture_adapter_on_windows (3, 4) (A32 platform_required).

e2e_m07_powershell_hook::powershell_hook.rationale: #[cfg(unix)]: Unix shell stubs exercise both timeout paths without compiling an executable. The hook's stdout and startup rows on Windows are powershell_hook_writes_nothing_to_stdout, powershell_hook_startup_with_an_unreachable_runtime and powershell_hook_activates_and_warms_the_default (A27-M07 platform_required).
#[cfg(unix)]: the start-failure stubs are Unix shell scripts with their mode bits set; Windows exercises a failing start through powershell_hook_missing_executable_leaves_the_error_history_alone.

e2e_cli_m07::enrollment_wait_explains_an.rationale: #[cfg(unix)]: the interrupted enrollment step is a Unix shell stub with its mode bits set; the explained-wait wording itself runs on Windows in cli_sync_wait_explains_itself.

e2e_tui_m07::windows_console::.rationale: #[cfg(windows)]: the TUI on a Windows pseudoconsole through heimdall_testkit::console::TerminalCommand (A20's and the TUI standalone row's Windows tests); their Unix rows are the pty:: cases.

A20.title: A20: the TUI is keyboard-only, responsive and restored: every view, focus, controls and results at 40x12 and 120x40, a key answered within 100 ms, a resize, no key acting on a frame not drawn (R-UX-05, R-UX-07)
A20.note: By reference, the M02, M03 and M05 TUI tests (their own indexes). U6's stale-page test arrives with U3 (revision 7).

A27-M07.title: A27 (M07 rows): the PowerShell hook writes nothing to the shell's stdout, bounds its child, and starts safely with no runtime, an unreachable runtime or a hostile state (R-SS-04)
A27-M07.note: Windows PowerShell 5.1 and 7 (both editions per run). macOS runs the 7 edition through pwsh. U7's rendered route-helper rows (A27's M06 consolidation) are not listed yet.

A32.title: A32: third-party composition: harnesses H1 and H2 each complete the seven deterministic tasks over the CLI, and the reference wrapper completes its journey over the local protocol, with no private file, database or state path read (R-AP-07, R-AP-08, R-UX-04, R-QU-05)

blocked_rows.platform: windows-11 reference wrapper journey over the named pipe
windows-11 task 5's login through the binding's own signing endpoint
blocked_rows.decision: by ruling (2026-11-23): on Windows nothing between `run` and the in-box ssh.exe can check that SSH_AUTH_SOCK names the disposable agent, so the isolated set uses IdentityAgent=none; proven on Unix only (WINDOWS_HELD in tests/e2e/harness_m07.rs)

A32.note: The Python suites of examples/reference-wrapper, examples/harnesses/cli and examples/harnesses/goal-loop run through tools/validation/check.sh and on Windows in the PC job. Held for revision 7: the wrapper's skew run against the M06 exit build, H2's call set from `schema show primitives` (U4b, U5h), pages and the A19 contract rows (U3). A32's LLM metrics are M09-T02.
